t: From Fanciful Hooks to Functional Tools: Architecting AI Workflows
s: This article details the iterative refinement of AI development workflows, focusing on user experience, git hygiene, and a pedagogical 'on-ramp' for AI education (AIE) tools. It highlights the strategic evolution from conceptualization to functional deliverables with a revised 'Hello World' notebook.
sub: AI development workflow architecture and refinement
Jupyter Notebook organization and Git hygiene
Pedagogical design of an AI 'Hello World' experience
Evolution of naming conventions for AI tools (e.g., URLinator to URLchecker)
User-centric design principles for AI tool development
